realizes.rationale: The surviving resolver compares the recorded source and memory endpoints and keeps missing operands explicit.
It resolves a provided number through the exact recorded leaf contract on both live and landed leaves.

Resolves a closed leaf from durable records, never from a worktree. It reads the leaf's recorded enclosure contract first. It then tries the recorded tree comparison: a leaf that recorded one reopens from its tree ids, and a leaf that recorded none proceeds to comparison-generation reopening with no converted/unconverted guard, then to the bare source range when no generation was published; an ambiguous or unreadable generation is refused rather than replaced. On a converted official line a leaf that recorded only a dataset comparison keeps its code sides and reports its knowledge sides legacy-unavailable, with no database read; legacy resolution uses the retained manifest's source sides.

An explicit number reopens that comparison from the recorded leaf contract even for a live leaf; no current-worktree capture or legacy-generation substitution occurs on this path. None retains ordinary resolution. Invalid context, absent enclosure and absent recorded number return named refusals.
